text:
alex: Morning — quick heads up: PR #2481 has a couple style/lint nits blocking merge. CI is failing on formatting and there was an accidental export rename. Can someone take a quick look? Want to merge in tonight's 6pm window.

pranav: I can glance now, but I have to head OOO at 5pm. If it's small I'll approve.

alex: Copying linter output:
`````
./server/cache.go:42:6: exported type kvCache should have comment or be unexported
./server/kvcache.go:10:6: exported var default_cache_size should have comment or be unexported
./server/kvcache.go:12:1: file is not gofmted with -s
`````

maria: Looks like two things: (1) gofmt, (2) accidental change to exported name. The linter wants `KVCache` exported type. Did you mean to make it unexported?

ryan: Don't change public API — keep `KVCache`. If you need internal rename, do `type KVCache struct { internal *kvCacheImpl }`. Also prefer small commit that runs `gofmt -w .` and add a short comment for exported type.

alex: OK, will revert the exported name. Plan:
`````
git checkout -- server/kvcache.go
# reapply only internal renames
gofmt -w .
git add -A && git commit -m "kvcache: fix formatting, keep KVCache exported; internal rename" --signoff
git push --force-with-lease
`````
I'll push in ~10m.

ci-bot: CI / fmt check failed — gofmt issues found (reported 2318000012)

maria: If you push the fix I can re-run reviews and approve.

alex: Pushed fix and amended commit, also added comment for exported type. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2481

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (2318000048)

pranav: LGTM. approving now.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll merge during the 6pm merge window unless anyone objects.

alex: Thanks all — merged and deployed canary (merged 2318000065).
